papers_and_supporting_note.scope: For every complete nontrivially valued K and algebraic valued extension M/K with L=completion(M), every good separated strict boundaryless pure analytic curve including singular and nonreduced structures, and every continuous finite real h, the ordinary CLD zero-Hessian equation holds downstairs iff it holds on X_L. On any good separated analytic X, every compact ordinary smooth scalar test on X_L exactly descends with compact support to a finite K-subfield E of M. No current-stability assumption. Original recognition, arbitrary-dimensional separable-current ascent, arbitrary transcendental ascent and two-sign regularization remain open.

continued_goal: All original atoms remain open; further research proceeds in small batches.
